summary: A sophisticated custom MAS implementation with a hierarchical architecture. While the framework design is excellent, the specific business logic for geographic filtering and price sorting is largely simulated or missing.

findings.description: Elegant custom MAS framework using a MessageBroker and RegionalCoordinator pattern.
findings.evidence: system.py and message_broker.py implementing internal routing

findings.description: The 2km radius filtering and price sorting are not functionally implemented; handlers return hardcoded/sample data.
findings.evidence: RegionalCoordinatorAgent._handle_agent_offer_response creates sample offers regardless of input.

findings.description: Properly uses asyncio.Queue and background tasks for agent message processing.
findings.evidence: _process_messages in agent.py uses asyncio.wait_for on a queue.

implementation_risks: System relies on sample data for core logic, making it a prototype rather than a functional system.
